query: SELECT TOP 101 pl_name, hostname, pl_rade, pl_rade_reflink, pl_bmasse, pl_bmasse_reflink, pl_orbper, pl_orbper_reflink, pl_eqt, pl_eqt_reflink, sy_vmag, sy_vmag_reflink, st_teff, st_teff_reflink, sy_dist, sy_dist_reflink, ra, ra_reflink, dec, discoverymethod, disc_facility, disc_refname, tran_flag FROM pscomppars ORDER BY pl_name
transformations: Parsed the Archive's JSON response into JSON records.
Re-serialized the records as UTF-8 JSON with two-space indentation and a trailing newline; field values were not otherwise changed.
